name: Lightning Bolt
summary: Blasts a 100-foot Line of lightning that deals Lightning damage.

m.text: a bit of fur and a crystal rod

stats.effect: A stroke of lightning forming a 100-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line blasts out from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the Line makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
stats.higherLevels: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 3.
